description: KEMP Virtual LoadMaster (VLM) is a virtualized edition of LoadMaster that can be deployed in the Cloud from Azure or AWS marketplaces (including the Government specific regions); in a virtual machine in any Cloud providers VMs; on private virtual infrastructures such as that from VMware, Hyper-V, VirtualBox, and Xen. VLM is ideal for use with IoT Platforms and infrastructure.

labeler.rationale: Describes deployment options for a virtualized load-balancing offering across public and private infrastructure, a conventional infrastructure function.
evidence_spans: a virtualized edition of LoadMaster that can be deployed in the Cloud from Azure or AWS marketplaces (including the Government specific regions); in a virtual machine in any Cloud providers VMs; on private virtual infrastructures such as that from VMware, Hyper-V, VirtualBox, and Xen.

parent_concerns: BOTH rationales infer load balancing, but source only names LoadMaster and lists virtual/cloud deployment options. No load-balancing operation is explicitly described. Evaluate evidence from literal text only, remove imported product knowledge, and retain weak/forced if deployment packaging alone lacks concrete functionality.
